sources.notes: The organiser's own 'Tramos de Carrera' page embeds a Google My Map titled 'Rally 2026', with folders SHAKEDOWN/FRIDAY/SATURDAY/SUNDAY. Each stage has a LineString plus start (SS/SSS) and finish (FSS) placemarks; there are also liaison lines, TC, STOP, refuel and service points. All 12 distinct stage roads (22 SS) are covered. Start/finish above are from the placemarks. The Trinidad and Artigas Este lines are digitised in reverse (first vertex = FSS); this was checked against the liaison lines, which end at SSS12/16 and SSS19/21. Matching to SS numbers is by the placemark labels (e.g. 'SS1/5'). Stage names match the itinerary except 'ARTIGAS ESTE' = itinerary 'Artigas 1/2'; RG recce table also calls SS19/21 'Artigas Este'. This match is confident. Haversine lengths of the lines vs v.1 km: Cambyreta 24.61/24.65, Nueva Alborada 15.78/15.66, Yerbateras 34.00/33.88, Autodromo 2.57/2.50, Bella Vista 21.25/21.15, Bella Vista Sur 11.90/11.57, Hohenau 19.54/19.40, Trinidad 14.95/15.00, Costanera 3.13/3.10, Encarnacion 9.59/10.26, Artigas Este 19.85/19.60, Artigas Oeste 8.58/8.44. These are hand-digitised lines, roughly accurate. Encarnacion is notably short (9.59 vs 10.26/10.21). The text on the same page describes 2025 stages, but the embedded map itself is the 2026 route.
sources.verification: Re-checked 2026-10-21 against itinerary v.1 (Rally Guide 1 pp. 54-56): line lengths on WGS84 vs official km within 2% except SS4/8 Autodromo (2.57 vs 2.50, +2.7%), SS10/14 Bella Vista Sur (11.90 vs 11.57, +2.8%) and SS18/22 Encarnacion (9.57 vs 10.26, -6.7%), which are shown as start/finish only (organiser SS/FSS placemarks). Press figures from a later, unpublished itinerary version (e.g. Encarnacion 10.21, Bella Vista Sur 10.95) are not used.
